verdict.rationale: An editor or engine could plausibly ship an MCP client, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Unreal Engine can connect to external MCP servers or use their tools. The probe finds no official Epic MCP work at all, and the community MCP projects it mentions expose Unreal to outside agents, which is the server role and not this one. Plugins, Python scripting and NNE are only developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.
